# Trusted setup

Two rounds. Round one made the powers of tau, round two made this circuit's
proving key on top of it. Each was sealed with a Bitcoin block hash fixed
before contributions closed.

To verify, put `pot16_final.ptau` (from the release page) in
`ptau/ceremony-round1/` and run `./ceremony/verify.sh`.
